artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: La chevalier
artworks.artist: after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a forest setting. The woman is seated on a tree trunk, while the man is kneeling beside her. The woman has long hair and wears a gown, while the man has curly hair and wears a tunic with a sword at his side. A horse stands in the background, surrounded by trees and tall grass.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: L'arbre
artworks.artist: Louis Petit after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals outdoors. One person is standing next to a tree, leaning against it, while the other person is kneeling beside them, holding hands. The standing woman has an elaborate hairstyle and is wearing a long dress with detailed patterns. The kneeling figure wears a head covering, loose-fitting attire, and looks up at the standing woman. The background displays a lush foliage landscape with trees and bushes.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: L'arbre
artworks.artist: Louis Petit after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in an outdoor setting. One figure, a woman, stands leaning against a tree. She has an elaborate hairstyle, wears a flowing dress with long sleeves, detailed bodice, and a cape. The second figure kneels beside her, holding her hand. The background shows lush foliage and trees. The scene is richly textured with deep etching techniques.

artworks.title: La fiancee du roi de Garbe: L'arbre
artworks.artist: Louis Petit after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor setting. One person is standing, leaning against a tree with a staff in hand. She wears a gown with patterns, a belt, and an elaborate updo. The other person is kneeling next to her, holding her hand. He wears a robe, a hat, and a belt. The background features a rural landscape with tall trees and various plants.

artworks.title: La coupe enchantee
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste-Michel Dupreel after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: Three men are in an ornate room. One man is seated in a plush chair, holding out a bowl or cup. Two men stand across from him at a table. The room is richly decorated with intricate wallpaper, framed paintings, and sculptures.

artworks.title: La coupe enchantee
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste-Michel Dupreel after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three men interacting in a detailed interior setting with lavish decor. The first man is seated on a cushioned chair, presenting a hat to the man in the middle. The second man, standing to the right, is leaning forward on a table, smiling. The third man, standing to the left of the second man, is pointing at the hat. The room is richly decorated with ornate wall paneling, paintings, hanging artworks, and vases, exuding elegance.

artworks.title: La coupe enchantee
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste-Michel Dupreel after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate interior scene with a richly decorated room. The room features elaborate frames and moldings on the walls, intricate patterns and artworks, including a large painting and an oval portrait. The furniture is ornate, with a finely carved table and a chair featuring decorative details. The room suggests a setting of opulence and wealth, indicative of a high social status or a formal setting. The artwork captures the elaborate detailing common in the period's style, focusing on textures and patterns in both the decor and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Le faucon
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun and Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals captured from head to below the knees. On the left, a man is seated on a chair with his legs crossed. His facial features are not detailed, but he has a hairstyle with curls. He is wearing an elegant suit with a coat, vest, and cravat. In the center, a woman is perched on the edge of a table, leaning forward as she works with a dish and cloth. Her hair is tucked under a bonnet, and she is dressed in modest, plain clothing with long sleeves. On the right, another woman is seated in an armchair, her body turned slightly towards the center. Her hair is styled in elaborate curls, and she is dressed in a detailed, fitted gown. A small dog lies on the floor in the foreground. The background shows a rustic interior with wooden beams, a staircase, and a shelf holding pots.

artworks.title: Le faucon
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun and Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: Three people are depicted in an interior setting. Two individuals are seated at a table while one person is standing on the stairs. The man sitting on the left is casually positioned, with his legs crossed and leaning back on the chair. He is engaging in conversation with the woman standing beside him. The man has styled hair and is wearing a suit with a dark jacket and light shirt. The woman seated on the right is elegantly dressed in a gown with intricate patterns. She has well-defined curls in her hair and is seated in a carved chair, gesturing delicately with her hands. The standing woman is wearing an apron over her dress and a cap over her hair, holding a dish as she talks with the others. A small dog is seen next to her on the floor. The background shows a wooden staircase leading to a cluttered loft area with textiles and household items, suggesting a cozy and rustic domestic interior.

artworks.title: Le faucon
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun and Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: Three figures are seated at a wooden table in a rustic interior setting. The man on the left wears 18th-century clothing, including a coat, waistcoat, and formal hairstyle. Across from him, a woman in an ornate dress sits in an armchair with elaborate hair styling. Another older woman is standing between them, placing a dish on the table. A small dog rests on the floor next to the man, with an empty plate nearby. The background features wooden beams, a loft area with laundry, and household items on shelves.

artworks.title: Le faucon
artworks.artist: Jean Dambrun and Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three people in an interior setting. Two are seated - a man and a woman - while a standing woman reaches out with a dish. The man is dressed in 18th-century clothing, seated on a bench, and the woman across from him wears similar attire and sits on an ornate chair. The standing woman wears simpler clothing with an apron and headscarf. A dog sits near the man's feet. The room has a wooden staircase, shelves with pottery, and draped fabric, with a rustic appearance.

artworks.title: Le petit chien
artworks.artist: French 18th Century
artworks.description: This is a drawn scene set in an elaborate bedroom. The image features a group of people surrounding a grand bed. The room is richly decorated with ornate elements like columns and molding. On the floor, a small dog stands on its hind legs. The figures show expressions and gestures of engagement. They are wearing period clothing.

artworks.title: Le pate d'anguilles
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene in a rustic interior. The image shows an indoor setting with wooden beams, a ladder, and various jars and dishes on a shelf. At the center of the image, a table is slightly tilted. There are dishes and what appears to be a jug placed on the floor. Items, possibly hats and other utensils, are scattered around the lower portion of the image. The composition features an intricate playing of light and shadow, adding depth to the setting and providing details to the rustic interior elements with precision. The artwork is finely detailed, giving a sense of liveliness to the depicted domestic scene.

artworks.title: Le pate d'anguilles
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with four individuals. In the foreground, a man is seated at a table, and a woman leans towards him from the left, extending her hand. Her body is shown from head to knee, and she wears a long-sleeved dress with a ruffled front. The seated man, shown from his head to his knees, wears a coat and breeches. A second woman stands over the man with her arm extended, wearing similar clothing. She leans in as if whispering. A third figure is visible in the background on an upper level, leaning over a railing; this person appears to be wearing a loose garment. Near the foreground are scattered objects including hats and a large urn. The setting suggests a rustic interior with a wooden beam and high shelf in the background, containing various pottery and household items. The space has a casual yet busy atmosphere with archways and shadows adding depth.

artworks.title: Le pate d'anguilles
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior domestic scene. Several individuals are centering their attention on a table with a cloth draping over the sides. One figure is on a chair or small stool, while others are standing or leaning forward. Items such as pots are on a shelf. Another person is leaning over a higher level bannister. The setting includes architectural columns, a bowl on the floor, and an ornate jug on the table, creating a sense of depth. An overhead arch adds to the visual richness of the environment, suggesting a domestic or kitchen setting. The textures emphasize details in clothing, pottery, and furniture surfaces.

artworks.title: Le pate d'anguilles
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows four people in an indoor setting with two levels. In the foreground, three individuals are near a table covered with a cloth. One person leans over the table, holding an object. Another sits beside them, reaching out towards the object. A third stands behind them, holding a tray. On the upper level, a fourth person leans over the railing, observing the scene below. The background features wooden beams, shelves with pottery and utensils, and an archway. Additional objects include a hat on the floor and a decorative urn near the table.

artworks.title: Le magnifique
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals shown from head to toe. The central figure, a man, stands with one hand on his hip and the other arm bent. He has a slightly smiling expression and wears a wig typical of the eighteenth century, along with ornate attire featuring a knee-length coat and breeches embellished with embroidery and lace. Another man to his right leans against a large curtain, with a serious demeanor, and wears similarly styled attire with a sash. He has closely cropped hair visible under his wig. To the left, a woman seated at a table holds a fan to her face. She wears a voluminous gown with a high neckline, adorned with lace, and a feather-decorated hairstyle. The background showcases an opulently decorated room with intricate wall patterns and heavy drapes, along with a cherubic figure perched atop a lavish canopy.

artworks.title: Le magnifique
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving touched with blue pencil
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals: two men and a woman. The woman is half-visible, seated on the left side of the image. She has an elaborate hairstyle adorned with a flower and holds a fan against her face with her left hand. Her attire includes a full-skirted dress with ruffled sleeves and a fitted bodice. One man stands to the right, partially turned towards the woman, dressed in a long coat with a ruffled shirt. The other man in the center stands with one hand on his hip and the other holding back a curtain. He wears a long coat with contrasting light and dark layers. The background showcases rich décor with ornate drapery, patterned walls, and an intricate relief of a cherub above.

artworks.title: Le magnifique
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Tilliard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an ornate interior setting. A woman sits on the left, holding a fan to her face. She wears a detailed gown with ruffled sleeves. Two men stand on the right. The man in the middle leans slightly forward with his hand on his hip. The man on the right has one hand on a curtain. The background features rich decorations like walls, drapery, and a decorative arch with cherubs and floral motifs.

artworks.title: La matrone d'Ephese
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in an interior setting. The image depicts figures in robes and classical architecture. An arched ceiling frames the upper part of the drawing, where a reclining figure is positioned over a decorative pedestal or monument. In the foreground, there are two figures; one is offering a tray and appears to be a helmeted soldier, while another figure is kneeling and attending to a resting figure on a stone or altar. The rendering is detailed, with attention to the drapery of the clothing, expressions of the figures, and ornate architectural elements.

artworks.title: La matrone d'Ephese
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with various figures in dynamic interaction. The scene depicts a richly ornamented interior space reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek architecture. The drawing shows a reclining figure above an archway, beneath which sit or stand several other figures. In the central foreground, one figure appears to comfort another who lies across a stone-like structure, while a warrior figure clad in a plumed helmet and holding a spear looks on. The background features a lit altar or pedestal with classical sculptures and reliefs adorning the space. The ceiling above the reclining figure is ornately detailed.

artworks.title: La matrone d'Ephese
artworks.artist: Jean-Louis Delignon and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene featuring an interior with figures, including a warrior, a woman tending to another figure, and several other classical elements. The scene takes place in an ornate, grand interior. A warrior stands to the right, holding a spear. Two women are closely interacting in the foreground; one seems to comfort or tend to another who is seated and looks distressed or exhausted. There is a lit urn or vessel in the center that appears to symbolize ceremonial or sacred activity, perhaps an offering. Statuesque figures and elaborate architectural details, such as ornate columns and ceiling motifs, surround the scene.

artworks.title: Belphegor
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The drawing shows a simple room with an earthen floor. A seated figure faces a standing figure, with a smaller figure on their laps and a barking dog at their feet. The room contains various items, including pots on shelves and a hanging perch with two birds near the doorway. Overhead, shelves and beams add depth to the environment, and objects such as baskets and dishes are placed around. Fine details and textures emphasize the homeliness and simplicity of the setting.

artworks.title: Belphegor
artworks.artist: Charles Emmanuel Patas and Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in an indoor setting. In the foreground, a man is seated in a wooden chair, holding a baby and gesturing towards a small dog on the floor. Beside him, a woman is seated, raising her arms in a startled manner. A young child looks over the chair. Near the doorway, an older man with a hat carries a stick and a cloth. The background includes pots and jars near a window, with birds perched outside and a landscape visible. Items like cookware and containers add detail to the scene.
